Mathematical_Condition: Homogeneous Dirichlet on Velocity: u_bar(0, t) = 0; Homogeneous Neumann on Geometry: del s / del x |_{x=0} = 0, del H / del x |_{x=0} = 0
Physical_Meaning: Symmetry ridge spine: velocity is antisymmetric (odd function) requiring Dirichlet u=0; geometry is symmetric (even function) requiring Neumann del s/del x = 0
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Staggered face velocity pinned: u_1/2 = 0.0 m s^-1 (Dirichlet); ghost cell reflection for surface slope: s_0 = s_1 (Neumann)
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Spurious mass leak across spine, unphysical divide deflation, artificial model divergence

Physical_Location: x = x_GL(t) (Transition from grounded bed to floating shelf)
Mathematical_Condition: Dirichlet Velocity from Schoof Boundary-Layer Flux: u_bar(x_GL, t) = q_GL / h_GL; q_GL = q_unbuttressed * [1 - omega_b * theta]^mu
Equation_or_Value: q_GL = [(rho_i * g * (1 - rho_i / rho_w)) / (4^n * A)]^(1/(m+1)) * C_bed^(-1/(m+1)) * h_GL^((m+n+3)/(m+1)) * [1 - omega_b * theta]^mu; u_GL = q_GL / h_GL
Physical_Meaning: Couples upstream driving stress to downstream boundary layer flux; essential Dirichlet condition for elliptic SSA on coarse grid
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Enforced as Dirichlet face velocity u_(N+1/2) = q_GL / h_GL in momentum solve and advective face flux in continuity; discrete Eulerian cell update prevents double-counting with ungrounding migration M_unground
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Artificial grid pinning, step-function discharge jumps, severe mesh-size dependence

Physical_Location: z = s(x, t) = z_b(x) + H(x, t) + FAC(x, t)
Mathematical_Condition: Kinematic solid-ice accumulation rate: a_dot_i = (rho_water / rho_i) * a_dot_we = (1000 / 917) * a_dot_we
Equation_or_Value: a_dot_i = 1.09051 * a_dot_we;  del(W * H)/del t + del(W * H * u_bar)/del x = W * a_dot_i
Physical_Meaning: RACMO2.3p2 water-equivalent SMB (m w.e. yr^-1) converted to solid-ice-equivalent thickness rate (m ice-eq yr^-1) using fresh water density rho_water=1000 kg m^-3
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Converted once upon staging: a_dot_i = 1.09051 * a_dot_we; enters finite-volume continuity source term as W_i * a_dot_i * Delta x
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Dimensional inconsistency, artificial elevation drift, violation of mass conservation

Mathematical_Condition: Power-law generalized friction law: tau_b = C_bed * |u_b|^(m - 1) * u_b; no basal melt on cold-based bed
Physical_Meaning: Basal resistance to sliding governed by bed roughness, till deformability, and effective pressure
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Basal drag term in 1D hybrid SSA momentum balance equation
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Runaway sliding blowup, zero basal resistance, numerical instability in deep troughs

Mathematical_Condition: Pattyn (2006) lateral drag: tau_wall = [ (5 * u_bar) / (A * W) ]^(1/n); F_lat = 2 * H * tau_wall
Physical_Meaning: Sidewall shear stress retards flow in narrow alpine fjords of Graham Land (Basin I-Ipp)
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Lateral resistance force term -2 * H * tau_lat added to 1D momentum equation
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Over-discharge by factor of 3-5 in narrow fjords due to neglecting sidewall resistance

Boundary_Interface: Floating Ice Shelf Calving Front (Ocean Interface)
Mathematical_Condition: Hydrostatic seawater pressure boundary condition + parameterized shelf-collapse scenario indicator
Equation_or_Value: theta_buttress in [0, 1] conditioned on sub-shelf basal melt thinning and external hydrofracture indicator
Physical_Meaning: Limits shelf extent; buttressing loss triggers grounding-line acceleration
Enforcement_Mechanism_in_Solver: Dynamic buttressing factor theta_buttress(t) parameterizes embayment backstress
Failure_Mode_if_Violated: Cannot claim internal 1D resolution of 2D hydrofracture; must be treated as scenario indicator
